original_question: For the equilibrium measure of Riesz energy on the hypercube Q^d, it is known that when -2 < s <= q - 2 the support lies in the union of the (q - 1)-dimensional faces and therefore s <= dim(supp(mu_eq)) <= q - 1. Improve the lower bound in this dimension estimate.
target_in_paper: Section 3, Problem 3.1 (Ryan Matzke): improve the lower bound in the dimension estimate (3) arising from the hypercube support-localization discussion. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2504.04845))
correct_elements: Your draft is aimed at the correct problem in the paper: the hypercube case in Section 3, where one studies the support of the equilibrium measure for the Riesz-energy minimization problem on a convex body and then asks, in Problem 3.1, to improve the lower bound in the dimension estimate (3). You also correctly focused on the support dimension rather than the broader neighboring questions about the detailed structure of the support or extensions to other convex bodies. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2504.04845))
missing_details: The draft should explicitly define μ_eq as a Borel probability measure minimizing the unweighted Riesz-energy functional I_s(μ) over probability measures supported on Q^d.
It should state the ambient space: Q^d is a d-dimensional hypercube in R^d.
It should define K_s as the Riesz s-kernel, since Section 3 introduces the problem through that kernel notation.
It should make explicit that the question concerns the bound labeled (3) in Section 3.
It should say what q denotes, or at least specify that q is the integer appearing in the known face-localization statement used to derive (3).

The paper writes dim(supp(μ_eq)) without defining a specific notion of dimension in Section 3; to stay paper-faithful, the refined question should retain that notation rather than silently replacing it by a different notion.

The paper's formulation here has no external field, no homogeneity/degree restriction, no nilpotency condition, and no 'for all sufficiently large m' clause; a stand-alone rewrite should avoid importing any such extra structure.
refined_question: Let Q^d ⊂ R^d be the d-dimensional hypercube, let K_s be the Riesz s-kernel, and let μ_eq be a Borel probability measure on Q^d minimizing the unweighted Riesz s-energy I_s(μ)=∫∫_{Q^d×Q^d} K_s(x,y) dμ(x) dμ(y). In the hypercube case, it is known that for an integer q with -2 < s ≤ q - 2, the support supp(μ_eq) is contained in the union of the (q - 1)-dimensional faces of Q^d, and hence one has the bound s ≤ dim(supp(μ_eq)) ≤ q - 1. Can one improve the lower bound s in this dimension estimate? ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2504.04845))
justification: The draft clearly targets Section 3 rather than the paper's introductory problems. In Section 3, the paper sets up the Riesz-energy minimization problem on compact convex bodies, specializes the discussion to the hypercube, derives the dimension bound labeled (3) from known support localization to lower-dimensional faces, and then states Problem 3.1 exactly as an instruction to improve the lower bound in (3). Your draft is therefore already very close to the official formulation; the main work is to restore the setup and notation so that the question is fully stand-alone. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2504.04845))
